lines.title: This is ITAP: identity, tracking and access, in one platform. Let's spend a day at Nova Tower.
lines.overview-workspace: Operators work from one screen. Every camera in the building is live, right next to the events it raises.
lines.overview-dashboard: The dashboard sums up the day: who is on site right now, who came in, and what needs attention.
lines.recognition-camera: Each camera recognises faces as people walk past. A known person is named on screen, live.
lines.recognition-wall: The live wall is the guard's screen: every camera at once, with alerts beside them, and the camera that needs attention lights up.
lines.people-faces: Every face the cameras see becomes an identity, known or not.
lines.people-photos: Each identity keeps its captures from every camera, so you know what a person looked like, and where.
lines.people-timeline: And their whole day reads as one timeline: when they arrived, which doors they used, and every zone along the way.
lines.places-tree: Places mirror the building itself. Floors, zones and rooms, each with its own live count.
lines.places-lobby: On the floor plan, cameras, doors and zones sit exactly where they are, with occupancy updating as people move.
lines.places-floor12: Every floor has its own plan, from the lobby up to the twelfth floor.
lines.access-list: Every door decision is recorded: who asked, where, and whether they got in.
lines.access-trace: Open any denial to see exactly how it was decided, down to the policy that said no.
lines.access-policies: Policy analytics show which rules do the work, and where doors are denied most often.
lines.incidents-events: Cameras and doors raise events all day long. Rules decide which of them matter.
lines.incidents-incident: When something serious happens, like a watch list match, an incident opens by itself, and escalates if nobody responds.
lines.incidents-rule: Before a new alert goes live, you can try it on recent events, and see exactly what it would have caught.
lines.analytics-charts: Analytics turn all of this into a clear picture of how the building is used.
lines.analytics-heatmap: The busiest hours stand out at a glance.
lines.analytics-flows: And you can see how people really move between areas.
lines.privacy-steps: Privacy is built in. When someone asks to be forgotten, their data is erased step by step, and every step is on record.
lines.privacy-retention: Retention rules clear out old data automatically, for each type of data.
lines.privacy-help: And help is written right into the console, for every part of it.
lines.outro: ITAP. One platform for identity, access and safety.
